Il contribue aux opérations de réception, rangement, préparation, inventaire et expédition des articles non médicaux conformément aux politiques, procédures et standards de Save the Children. Il veille à la tenue correcte des documents de stock et assiste dans l'enregistrement des mouvements de stock dans les systèmes en vigueur, Etendue Du Poste Reporte au : Warehouse Officer ou à son délégué Direct: N/A Employés devant reporter à cette position : N/A Indirect : N/A Responsabilités Budgétaires : N/A Dimensions du rôle :Le poste est basé à Bunia et sera en interaction avec les acheteurs, les programmes ainsi que le Finance. Responsabilités Assister le Warehouse Officer dans la réception, le stockage et la distribution des articles non médicaux. Décharger, contrôler et vérifier les marchandises reçues conformément aux documents de livraison. Ranger les articles dans les emplacements appropriés tout en respectant les règles de stockage et de sécurité. Veiller à la propreté et à l'organisation permanente de l'entrepôt. Participer aux inventaires physiques périodiques et ponctuels. Vérifier les quantités reçues par rapport aux bons de livraison. Identifier et signaler tout dommage ou écart lors de la réception des marchandises. Préparer les articles destinés à l'expédition selon les demandes approuvées. Participer à l'emballage, l'étiquetage et au chargement des marchandises. S'assurer que les documents d'expédition sont correctement complétés avant le départ des marchandises. Appliquer les procédures de gestion de stock en vigueur. Respecter les principes FIFO pour les articles concernés. Veiller à la sécurité des biens stockés ainsi qu'au respect des règles HSE dans l'entrepôt. Contribuer à la prévention des pertes, vols, dommages et détériorations. Informer immédiatement le Warehouse Officer de tout incident affectant les stocks ou les installations. Les responsabilités mentionnées ci-dessus ne sont pas exhaustives. Le titulaire pourra être amené à exécuter toute autre tâche compatible avec son niveau de compétence et demandée par sa hiérarchie afin de soutenir les opérations de Save the Children. Qualifications Être titulaire au minimum d’un Diplôme d’État ; un diplôme de niveau Bac+3 en sciences économiques et de Gestion, Logistique, Administration ou domaine connexe constitue un atout. Experience Et Competences Essentielles Justifier d’au moins 1 à 2 ans d’expérience pertinente en gestion d’entrepôt, gestion des stocks ou logistique (1 an pour les titulaires d’un Bac+3 et 2 ans pour les titulaires d’un Diplôme d’État). Une expérience de stage professionnel d’une durée minimale de 12 mois dans un domaine pertinent au sein d’une ONG sera également prise en compte. Bonne connaissance des principes et procédures de gestion des stocks et de l’entreposage. Bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques de base, notamment Microsoft Excel et Word. Excellentes capacités d’organisation, de planification et de rigueur dans l’exécution des tâches. Aptitude à travailler efficacement sous pression et à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant. Capacité à travailler en équipe et à maintenir de bonnes relations professionnelles avec les différentes parties prenantes. Bonnes compétences en communication orale et écrite en français. Sens élevé de l’intégrité, de la confidentialité et du respect des procédures organisationnelles. Engagement envers les valeurs, les principes et les politiques de sauvegarde de Save the Children. Avantageuses Connaissance de l’Anglais About Us Save the children India employ approximately 300 people across the globe and work on the ground in over 100 countries to help children affected by crises, or those that need better healthcare, education and child protection. We also campaign and advocate at the highest levels to realise the right of children and to ensure their voices are heard. We are working towards three breakthroughs in how the world treats children by 2030: No child dies from preventable causes before their 5th birthday All children learn from a quality basic education and that, Violence against children is no longer tolerated We know that great people make a great organization, and that our employees play a crucial role in helping us achieve our ambitions for children. We value our people and offer a meaningful and rewarding career, along with a collaborative and inclusive environment where ambition, creativity, and integrity are highly valued.

Improving test frameworks, documentation, and processes to enhance long-term efficiency and reliability. review_candidates.title: RF Sales Manager - mmWave & Beamformer ICs
review_candidates.description: Job Title: RF Sales Manager - mmWave & Beamformer ICs Location: REMOTE - preference for candidates on the East Coast Compensation: $150K - $200K base DOE plus bonus and equity  Requirements: RFIC Sales, mmWave, Beamformer ICs, Satcom / Defense Markets, Design Wins Position Overview We are seeking an experienced RF Sales Manager to drive revenue and customer success for our mmWave and Beamformer IC (BFIC) product portfolio. The ideal candidate will combine deep technical knowledge of mmWave RFICs, beamforming architectures and Antenna-in-Package (AiP)/phased array solutions with proven account management skills in commercial, SATCOM, and defense markets. This role is responsible for owning strategic customer relationships, securing design wins, leading forecasting and revenue planning, and coordinating cross-functional teams to accelerate product adoption and market share. Candidates with backgrounds from companies such as   Qorvo, Skyworks, MACOM, Anokiwave, Analog Devices, Renesas, and Movandi are especially encouraged to apply. Key Responsibilities Develop and manage strategic relationships with customers and partners across commercial, SATCOM, and defense segments to drive adoption of mmWave and Beamformer IC solutions. Identify, qualify, and close design wins for BFICs, RFICs, and AiP/phased-array solutions by collaborating with customers' system and RF design teams. Act as the primary technical and commercial point of contact for assigned accounts, translating customer requirements into product opportunities and internal development priorities. Lead account planning, forecasting and revenue planning for assigned customers, maintaining an accurate pipeline and quarterly/monthly revenue outlook. Coordinate cross-functional teams (product management, applications engineering, marketing, supply chain and R&D) to support customer evaluations, prototype programs and production ramp. Provide competitive and market intelligence on mmWave, beamforming, phased array and AiP technologies to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market strategy. Drive technical reviews, architecture discussions and system-level integration efforts with customer engineering teams to accelerate time-to-design-in. Negotiate commercial terms, manage contract processes and support order capture through to production shipments. Develop customer success programs, post-design-in support and escalation management to ensure long-term revenue retention and upsell opportunities. Represent the company at industry events, customer meetings and technical conferences to promote products and build market presence. Frequent travel to customers (40-50%) Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, or related field; MBA or equivalent commercial experience is a plus. 3+ years of RF account management, field sales, or business development experience with a focus on RFICs, mmWave or microwave product lines; experience selling into SATCOM or defense customers is highly desirable. Strong technical understanding of mmWave RFICs, beamformer ICs (BFICs), phased array antennas, and Antenna-in-Package (AiP) integration. Proven track record of achieving design wins and managing the customer lifecycle from evaluation to production shipment. Experience with forecast-driven revenue planning, CRM pipeline management, and quarterly sales forecasting. Demonstrated ability to work with cross-functional teams including applications engineering, product management and R&D to resolve technical issues and meet customer timelines. Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills; able to engage at both technical and executive levels. Familiarity with regulatory and procurement processes common in SATCOM and defense markets, including technical review boards and contract vehicles. Willingness to travel to customer sites and industry events as required (domestic and international). Self-starter with strong organizational skills, customer focus, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced product development environment. #Enghp Benefits Medical/Dental/Vision benefits Vacation/PTO Stock Option Grants Flexible Work Arrangements 401K w/ 3.5% match Email Your Resume In Word To Mike.Vandenbergh@CyberCoders.com Looking forward to receiving your resume through our website and going over the position with you. review_candidates.title: Quran
review_candidates.description: Company Description SUBULU SALAAM is a faith-based organization dedicated to promoting Quranic education and values within the community in Adama. The organization focuses on providing structured learning environments where individuals of different ages and backgrounds can deepen their understanding of the Quran. SUBULU SALAAM aims to foster spiritual growth, ethical conduct, and community cohesion through accessible and high-quality religious instruction. The team works collaboratively to support learners, families, and community members in their educational journeys. Applicants joining SUBULU SALAAM will be part of a mission-driven environment that values respect, integrity, and service. Role Description The Quran role at SUBULU SALAAM is a full-time, on-site position based in Adama. Day-to-day responsibilities include teaching Quran recitation and memorization, guiding learners in proper Tajweed, and helping students understand key Quranic concepts and values. The role involves preparing lesson plans, organizing class materials, assessing learners’ progress, and providing constructive feedback to support continuous improvement. The individual will also collaborate with other staff to schedule classes, participate in community programs, and ensure a respectful, inclusive, and safe learning atmosphere. Additional duties may include maintaining attendance records, communicating with parents or guardians, and contributing ideas to enhance the overall Quranic curriculum. Qualifications Strong knowledge of the Quran, including recitation, memorization, and application of Tajweed rules. Demonstrated experience teaching or tutoring Quran to diverse age groups in a structured setting. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage learners patiently and respectfully. Ability to plan lessons, manage classroom time, and maintain organized records of learner progress. Commitment to ethical conduct, cultural sensitivity, and promoting an inclusive learning environment. Fluency in relevant local languages and working proficiency in English is an advantage. Prior experience in religious education centers, schools, or community organizations is beneficial. Formal religious studies or certifications from a recognized institution are preferred.

review_candidates.title: Project Support Associate
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Project Support Associate Monthly Pay: $3,932 - $5,682 USD per month Summary: This role sits within a project support team guided by a project manager, working alongside task owners and internal stakeholders. You help keep project activities organized by updating task information, preparing meeting notes, and making outstanding actions visible to the people responsible. Your support gives the team a dependable view of progress so small gaps can be addressed before they delay shared work. This fully remote position lets you work from home in Maryland, United States, with all duties performed at a desk through online systems. The role requires a 40-hour weekly commitment. Working days and shift times may vary. Job Responsibilities: • Receive project support requests through shared email and task queues, identify the requested action, and confirm missing information with the requester. • Check task descriptions, assigned owners, target dates, and current status against the project manager's instructions before entering or updating details. • Maintain task boards in a project management tool such as monday.com, keeping assignments and progress updates consistent with approved project plans. • Update project trackers using a spreadsheets and data entry tool such as Microsoft Excel, checking entries for missing dates, duplicates, and inconsistencies. • Prepare meeting agendas from team updates, capture decisions and action items during discussions, and share clear notes with the relevant participants. • Follow up with task owners when updates are missing or target dates approach, recording responses and the next agreed action. • Flag blocked tasks, conflicting updates, and potential delays to the project manager, providing enough context for decisions without changing priorities independently. • Assemble routine progress summaries that distinguish completed work, pending actions, and items awaiting decisions for team reviews and stakeholder updates. • Support project reviews and closeout by confirming completed actions with owners, updating task status, and organizing lessons shared by the team. • Meet quality expectations through accurate updates, timely turnaround, complete notes, and dependable follow-up, using feedback from the project manager to improve. Qualifications: • High school diploma or equivalent. • No experience required; related experience supporting projects, team activities, or office tasks preferred. • Basic understanding of project lifecycle management, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, and closeout, with willingness to learn established team methods. • Introductory familiarity with project management methodologies, including waterfall project management, and willingness to learn terminology from the Project Management Body of Knowledge (PMBOK). • Comfort learning task boards and spreadsheets, checking entries carefully, and following consistent steps for updates and progress summaries. • Ability to read project plans, recognize unclear assignments, and ask focused questions rather than make unsupported assumptions about scope or deadlines. • Clear written and verbal communication for meeting notes, courteous reminders, project reviews, and concise explanations of outstanding actions. • A reliable computer, high-speed internet, and quiet private workspace, plus availability for the 40-hour weekly commitment and agreed working days and shift times. • Authorization to work in the United States. Perks & Benefits: • Fully remote work with desk-based responsibilities carried out from your home workspace. • Structured onboarding and training on a project management tool such as monday.com and a spreadsheets and data entry tool such as Microsoft Excel. • Regular check-ins with the project manager for practical guidance, feedback, and questions. • Opportunities to build project support, task tracking, meeting note preparation, and team communication skills. • Health coverage, paid leave, a 401(k), bonus opportunities, and stipends.
